label: Gulf Coast
definition: MPC's Gulf Coast refining region: the Galveston Bay (Texas City, Texas) and Garyville, Louisiana refineries.

label: Mid-Continent
definition: MPC's Mid-Continent refining region: the Catlettsburg, Robinson, Detroit, El Paso, St. Paul Park, Canton, Mandan and Salt Lake City refineries.

label: West Coast
definition: MPC's West Coast refining region: the Los Angeles, Anacortes and Kenai refineries.
